name: Rubik's x Star Wars Cubers 3x3 (Mandalorian)
description: The Rubik's x Star Wars Cubers 3x3 (Mandalorian) is a themed 3x3 cube where the puzzle displays the Mandalorian’s helmet from every angle. It comes with a custom stand shaped like his armored body, making it both a playable cube and a display-worthy collectible for Star Wars fans.
